name: The Archivist
heist_powers: Suspend: switch off one law in the current realm for 10 s (1 use). Reveal: show every ward in the realm (2 uses). Recall: bring a knocked-out character back at 40% (1 use; the Revival row, 7.3; 12.20).
at_home: Lab experiments 20% faster. On guard: when an alarm sounds, the crew is shown to every guard for 5 s.

name: The Tinkerer
heist_powers: Invert: turn a law into its opposite for 10 s, such as Half gravity into heavy gravity (1 use). Jam: disable a ward for 12 s (2 uses). Plank: lay a 4-tile shortcut over a gap for 15 s (2 uses).
at_home: Buildings cost 10% less. On guard: the first ward the crew disables rearms after 5 s.

name: The Gardener
heist_powers: Vine bridge: join two points up to 6 tiles apart for 20 s (1 use). Renew: heal the crew 30% over 5 s (1 use). Decoy: plant a sapling guards chase for 8 s (2 uses).
at_home: Gardens make 15% more. On guard: hedges and wards in the Heart heal 50% faster.

name: The Wanderer
heist_powers: Copy: take one enemy law and carry it around the crew for the rest of the heist (1 use). Rift: open a two-way rift between two realms already visited for 20 s (1 use). Tailwind: crew moves 40% faster for 6 s (2 uses).
at_home: The Observatory offers one more target. On guard: raiders can't call their skiff to one chosen outer realm for the first 60 s.
